notes.title: DEFINITIVE UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TBDpgNgl.png[/img]

The development of [i]Vikings Hnefatafl: Kings of the Dark Age[/i] has come to an end with this content-filled update!
If need arises, patches can still be released. New content however will not be added.

UPDATE CONTENTS

[list]
[*]Four new maps for Custom Battles: 1x small SP/1x large SP/1x small MP/1x large MP
[*]new Statistics for post-battle
[*]larger windowed mode size
[*]Campaign cutscenes now skippable
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov 12
notes.content:
[list]
[*]a bunch of new Custom Maps have been added to both single- and two-player Custom Battle modes! The maps have a 50-50 ratio of Small and Large Board sizes.
[/list]
